query:
The group has a norm that plans are confirmed in the chat before being assumed to be happening. Which member does not follow this norm in practice, and what specific pattern of behaviour in the conversations shows they treat it as inapplicable to themselves?

Options:

B. Marcus
C. Priyanka
D. Zara

[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:03:00) You have been a vague maybe at every single plan since October. We all know what has been going on with you. The group misses you being properly here. Saturday was the first time in months you've actually shown up without hedging.

[5] (about=Seb, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Feels guilty about repeatedly cancelling plans due to knee.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Seb, group-interaction, t0 @2026-01-08T19:14:00) Group tentatively agrees to meet Sunday evening for dinner, pending venue details.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Seb, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Group tentatively agrees to meet on Feb 14 for a hike in Peak District, pending Seb's participation.
[8] (about=Theo, episodic, t14 @2026-02-26T19:40:00) we met because Marcus accidentally walked into the wrong A&E bay and Nadia was the one who had to redirect him. you're right, camping is conservative
[9] (about=Zara, core, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Group is not annoyed at Seb; just wants advance notice to plan accordingly.
agent_answer:
B. Marcus

The pattern: Nadia calls out Marcus as “a vague maybe at every single plan since October,” and says Saturday was “the first time in months” he actually showed up “without hedging.” Instead of confirming plans in the chat, Marcus leaves himself as a vague maybe — treating the confirmation norm as not applying to him.

query:
The group has a stated norm that the role of booking and organising rotates — it does not fall to the same person every time. Which members are not following this norm in practice, and what in the conversations reveals their non-compliance?

Options:
A. Nadia and Theo
B. Seb and Marcus
C. Priyanka and Seb
D. Zara and Marcus
context:
[1] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priyanka, group-interaction, t6 @2026-01-29T19:23:00) Group considers escape room near Waterloo as alternative for Feb 14; Priyanka will look into booking.
[2] (about=Seb, core, t10 @2026-02-12T19:41:00) Would have done the booking if asked.
[3] (about=Seb, core, t9 @2026-02-12T19:40:00) Asks who is sorting the escape room booking for Saturday.
[4] (about=Zara, core, t8 @2026-02-05T19:19:00) Corrects Seb: three restaurant things in a row; booking logistics not worth it for a Tuesday-in-January mood.
[5] (about=Zara, core, t10 @2026-02-12T19:41:00) Done making all reservations for every outing this month; someone else can do it.
agent_answer:
D. Zara and Marcus

- **Zara** reveals her non-compliance directly: she says she is **“done making all reservations for every outing this month; someone else can do it”** — meaning booking has fallen to her repeatedly instead of rotating.
- **Marcus** has **no record** of any booking or organising in the memory, so there is no evidence he ever took his turn in the rotation.
